Q9024.reason: If the jury believes the suspect, the nightstick beating for mere cursing was excessive force and his punch was privileged self-defense even during a lawful arrest.

Q9025.reason: Zoning compliance does not bar relief, and a house that would wipe out an existing solar use when another placement is available is an unreasonable private nuisance, so the categorical judgment for the neighbor should be reversed.

Q9027.reason: Civil law is the body of law that establishes rights between persons and provides redress when those rights are violated.
